python3 -c "
import math
V_initial = 429.5
V_final = 807.0
t = 10
r = math.log(V_final / V_initial) / t
print(f'V_initial: {V_initial}')
print(f'V_final: {V_final}')
print(f'Ratio: {V_final/V_initial}')
print(f'ln(ratio): {math.log(V_final/V_initial)}')
print(f'Continuously compounded growth rate: {r}')
print(f'Rounded to 3 decimal places: {round(r, 3)}')
"
